$comment: Example: Bash script for log analysis and metric extraction

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Log analysis script
LOG_FILE="$1"
ERROR_THRESHOLD="$2"

echo "Analyzing log file: $LOG_FILE"

# Count error occurrences
ERROR_COUNT=$(grep -ci "error" "$LOG_FILE" || echo 0)
WARNING_COUNT=$(grep -ci "warning" "$LOG_FILE" || echo 0)
TOTAL_LINES=$(wc -l < "$LOG_FILE")

# Generate JSON report
cat <<EOF
{
  "error_count": $ERROR_COUNT,
  "warning_count": $WARNING_COUNT,
  "total_lines": $TOTAL_LINES,
  "threshold_exceeded": $([ "$ERROR_COUNT" -gt "$ERROR_THRESHOLD" ] && echo "true" || echo "false")
}
EOF

if [ "$ERROR_COUNT" -gt "$ERROR_THRESHOLD" ]; then
  echo "WARNING: Error count ($ERROR_COUNT) exceeds threshold ($ERROR_THRESHOLD)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

exit 0

outputs.StatusMessage: Log analysis completed: 7 errors, 23 warnings found in 1542 lines
